ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (dark grey/black) base covering approximately 75% of the surface area, punctuated by high-intensity (white/cream) focal regions concentrated in the upper-mid sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels form a concentrated, irregular mottle in the upper-mid region of the left lobe. On the right lobe, a larger contiguous high-intensity field is mapped along the upper-outer quadrant, bisected by low-intensity vertical linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 48 degrees, extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably deep, non-uniform peaks and valleys on the upper-inner boundary of both lobes, resulting in a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve transitioning into acute, upward-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel groups (barnacles) are localized along the distal leading and trailing edges of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four distinct, roughly parallel vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible traversing the high-intensity patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged excision or deep notch located on the upper-distal margin of the right lobe, accompanied by heavy peripheral calcified colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'piano-key' or vertical bar-code pigmentation pattern visible within the white field of the right lobe.
